AV0029.reason: Asp.Versioning.Abstractions 10.2.1 emits AV0029 on ASP.NET Core 11 OpenAPI wiring (including source-generated OpenApiXmlCommentSupport.generated.cs) because Asp.Versioning.OpenApi 10.2.3 requires Microsoft.OpenApi [2.7.5, 3.0.0) while Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi 11.0.0 requires [3.11.0, 4.0.0).
AV0029.removeWhen: Asp.Versioning.OpenApi 11.x ships supporting Microsoft.OpenApi 3.x and App.Api adopts it.

AV0030.reason: Asp.Versioning.Abstractions 10.2.1 emits AV0030 requiring WithDocumentPerVersion() from Asp.Versioning.OpenApi, which cannot be installed alongside Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi 11.0.0.
AV0030.removeWhen: Asp.Versioning.OpenApi 11.x ships supporting Microsoft.OpenApi 3.x and App.Api adopts it.
